scenes.summary: Captain Jack loses his map and begins a search.
scenes.text: Captain Jack could not find his treasure map and asked his crew to help him search for it.
scenes.image_prompt: pirate looking for lost map on ship crew helping cartoon style
scenes.story: Captain Jack lost his treasure map and set out with his crew to find it. They sailed to an island and faced a storm but stayed brave. On the island, they found a monkey holding the map. After getting it back kindly, they followed it to find a magic seashell. The shell made soft ocean sounds, and they felt happy and proud of their teamwork.
